name: hospet-delivery
description: Local grocery delivery platform for Hospet — customer PWA, rider app and admin console over a Supabase/Postgres core.

scripts.db:reset: dropdb --if-exists hospet_test && createdb hospet_test && psql -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d hospet_test -f supabase/migrations/0001_schema.sql && psql -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d hospet_test -f supabase/migrations/0002_functions.sql && psql -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d hospet_test -f supabase/seed.sql
scripts.db:test: npm run db:reset && psql -q -d hospet_test -f supabase/tests/lifecycle_test.sql && ./supabase/tests/oversell_test.sh hospet_test 10
